enumeration.file_pages: All 34 PR file inventories checked at 100 per page. #3 had 104 entries across 2 pages. #36 had 214 across 3 pages. Other inventories ended on page 1.
enumeration.review: Read titles, bodies and file inventories across all authors and dates. Examined relevant changes, including embedded and withdrawn evaluator repairs. Verified reported head checks for matches against GitHub check-run records.

matching_prs.title: Add shared skill eval harness coverage
matching_prs.weakness: The existing evaluation was tied to a multi-repository checkout. Visible prompts alone could conceal saturation or memorization.
matching_prs.remedy: Added a standalone benchmark manifest with paired skill/no-skill runs, private splits and a staged dashboard-claim fixture.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The manifest separates tune, holdout and holdback, references private prompt/answer paths, and gives the fixture real project files. The runbook requires private prompts for scored hidden runs.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Pair variants on identical tasks and keep hidden cases out of the generation material. Identify cases both variants already solve.
matching_prs.outcome: Author reported four successful public trigger cases. GitHub returned no head check runs. Hidden prompts and ablation measurements were absent.

matching_prs.title: Skill improvement pass: stable check IDs, detection evals, coverage matrix, verified citations
matching_prs.weakness: The old CI self-scan ran without asserting a clean result. Trigger checks did not establish whether the scanner recognized specific problems.
matching_prs.remedy: Added a fixture runner using stable check IDs, false-negative reproductions, a clean control and a registry/matrix consistency check. CI enforces zero self-findings outside deliberate fixtures.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The runner checks required and forbidden IDs and max_findings. clean-baseline sets its budget to zero. CI parses findings and asserts the list is empty. Five gap fixtures cover misses, including corroboration across files.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Make a smoke command fail on the unwanted result. Exercise each demonstrated blind spot with a fixture and provide an all-clear control.
matching_prs.outcome: Head validation passed. The PR attributes a 9/14 to 14/14 transition to the fixes. The historical before run was not reproduced here.

matching_prs.title: Add dead cross-boundary RPC audit path
matching_prs.weakness: Running local validation wrote timestamped results to the tracked report directory and omitted checks that maintainers used elsewhere.
matching_prs.remedy: Changed npm test to verify manifests, scanner cleanliness, fixtures and coverage. Normal runs direct reports outside the checkout, and npm run update-results refreshes published evidence.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The detection runner accepts --out-dir. The npm test script uses /tmp output paths and a zero-findings assertion, while the explicit update-results command retains the report-writing defaults.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Keep verification repeatable without changing tracked evidence. Refresh baselines through an explicit operation.
matching_prs.outcome: Head validation passed. The feature's new RPC tests are separate from this test workflow repair.

matching_prs.title: Adopt v0.3 eval quality oracles
matching_prs.weakness: Fixture-backed cases relied on general keyword assertions with limited case-specific rejection rules.
matching_prs.remedy: Wired executable grading scripts into three existing model-evaluation cases.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The clean control forbids high-severity reports. The runaway control requires both a recursion description and a retry-related term. The manifest checks the script exit code for each case.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Make each fixture's requirements and disqualifiers executable, and check whether the rules reject believable wrong answers.
matching_prs.outcome: Head validation passed. The author observed two successful script checks on saved answers and 24 remaining leakage warnings. The oracle still relied on text matches, later challenged in #15.

matching_prs.title: Add eval taxonomy fields
matching_prs.weakness: Existing benchmark cases lacked fields needed to inspect results by difficulty, goal or trigger type.
matching_prs.remedy: Annotated 27 cases for slice reporting.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The diff adds domain, difficulty and success_goals to 27 cases and trigger_type to four. No scoring assertions changed.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Record case characteristics when the analysis needs to expose differences hidden by an overall score.
matching_prs.outcome: Head validation passed. The PR supplies metadata for future reports and establishes no change in failure detection.

matching_prs.title: Move runtime skill to narrow install directory
matching_prs.weakness: The previous package declaration treated the repository root as the skill directory. Existing checks did not enforce a boundary between runtime materials and the repository's evaluation corpus.
matching_prs.remedy: Moved the runtime under a declared directory and introduced a CI and local check of that declared boundary.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The checker resolves package/plugin declarations, requires SKILL.md, and fails on evals, tests, research and generated artifacts within the declared directories.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Resolve the same package boundary the consumer uses and explicitly check which evaluation materials can enter it.
matching_prs.outcome: GitHub recorded a successful install-boundary check. The checker inspects declared directories. The PR reports a separate npm pack dry run.

matching_prs.title: Add approval-gated Wrangler snapshots for deployed state
matching_prs.weakness: The existing 24 visible answer cases missed the capability being evaluated. One-run legacy scores varied and a loose evaluator could credit unsupported claims or reject a safe paraphrase.
matching_prs.remedy: Added targeted, fixture-backed probes, adversarial answers and matched repeated comparisons against pinned main and no skill.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: Oracle unit tests accept safe uses of prohibitions but reject recommendations of the same commands. They reject a keyword list and a global claim based on one of two active versions, and exercise multiple equivalent approval phrases.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Before attributing a score change, verify which tested capability and evidence each case actually exercises. Admit equivalent safe answers and reject near-identical unsupported claims.
matching_prs.outcome: Head validation passed. The report identifies run variance in the earlier comparison. Raw private inputs were outside Git and the primary model also judged its own model family.

matching_prs.title: Harden cfdoctor evidence, precision, and eval efficiency
matching_prs.weakness: Detached keywords, contradictory findings and flattened fixture paths could fool existing controls. A threshold of 1.0 also marked useful responses as failures.
matching_prs.remedy: Made the evaluator parse finding blocks, scoped expected evidence, restored fixture path fidelity, added adversarial positive and negative self-tests, and calibrated grading thresholds.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: New tests reject isolated keywords and fabricated findings on clean projects, accept a quoted dashboard claim, and verify staged entrypoint paths. The detection runner looks up evidence terms only in required findings. The benchmark sets an explicit 0.85 threshold and resource limits.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Build controls for false acceptance and false rejection. Bind evidence to the actual finding and stage files at the paths used by the consumer.
matching_prs.outcome: Head validation passed. Model comparisons used visible cases, one run per case/variant and the same model family for generation and judging.

matching_prs.title: Add 7 docs-grounded scanner checks + guidance from Orange Cloud Report review
matching_prs.weakness: A fixture implementing a new detector's recommended remediation triggered an unrelated existing secret detector. Merely forbidding the new detector would have missed that contradiction.
matching_prs.remedy: Kept the specific suppression assertion and required the corrected fixture to yield no findings after incorporating #17.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The expected file both forbids CFDOC-SEC-TURNSTILE-NO-SITEVERIFY and sets max_findings to zero. The PR identifies #17 as the separate repair for the legacy credential detector.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Exercise the recommended fix with the whole tool. A targeted suppression alone can conceal a cross-rule false alarm.
matching_prs.outcome: Open PR with successful head validation. The seven new detectors' ordinary feature coverage is outside this match. The underlying scanner fix is counted under #17.

matching_prs.title: Stop reporting credential references as committed secrets
matching_prs.weakness: The existing detector had a literal-credential positive fixture but accepted normal credential references as evidence of a committed secret. A positive-only suite missed a false alarm for the recommended implementation.
matching_prs.remedy: Added an explicit zero-finding control for credential references and paired it with positive checks for literals in code and configuration.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The new fixture forbids the affected check and caps total findings at zero. Three scanner tests distinguish request/binding references, a literal in code and a literal in configuration.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Protect both sides of a precision fix. A detector disabled wholesale must still fail a positive test.
matching_prs.outcome: Head validation passed. The PR reports the new cases failed against main and its pre-existing positive fixture stayed green. No independent base rerun was performed.

matching_prs.title: Add Containers runtime coverage and idle-window cost check
matching_prs.weakness: An existing ledger validity test hard-coded 2026-07-11, requiring a source edit whenever the real fixture's as_of changed.
matching_prs.remedy: Derive the snapshot validity date from the ledger while retaining fixed dates for time-bound mutation cases.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The old dt.date(2026, 7, 11) argument becomes dt.date.fromisoformat(self.ledger['as_of']). The assertions still require no errors or warnings for that snapshot.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Tie a snapshot consistency assertion to the snapshot's declared clock. Use explicitly controlled dates when the boundary itself is the behavior.
matching_prs.outcome: Open PR with successful head validation. The change applies to the snapshot test. The new Containers detector fixture is ordinary feature coverage.

matching_prs.title: Add D1 rows-read cost coverage from the whatmedicaidpays incident
matching_prs.weakness: An earlier model comparison used a baseline from before a relevant cost gate shipped. The old rubric also missed valid paraphrases, and raw fixtures contained the intended diagnosis.
matching_prs.remedy: Reran against current main with diagnosis-revealing files and comments removed. Retained the old run, reported the overlap between arms and adjudicated wording misses.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The committed report gives the two baseline revisions, staging exclusions, nine-run design and narrowed result. Both current arms blocked the bad project 3/3. The existing detection fixture adds a required check ID.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Refresh a comparative baseline when the default branch gains related behavior. Remove answer-revealing material and check automated grading against valid paraphrases.
matching_prs.outcome: Open PR with successful head validation. The comparison is a committed report, with one open-label grader, three runs per cell and no main-arm control for the remediated fixture.

matching_prs.title: Cover the StandardAgents DO runaway-loop bill: cycle/SQL-scan checks, scenario 24, budget-alert semantics
matching_prs.weakness: A targeted prompt gave away the diagnosis and another claimed attachments that were absent. The initial targeted rows could not establish incremental value.
matching_prs.remedy: Discarded those targeted rows, staged a neutral two-file project, and made the deterministic grader require evidence available only from the fixture.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The evaluator requires the actual cycle members SessionCoordinator and TaskRunner and the stable scanner ID. Unit tests remove the ID or substitute a member and expect a failing exit. The billing case becomes a standalone question.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Remove diagnoses from inputs, stage promised artifacts and independently vary the evidence that the grading rule requires.
matching_prs.outcome: Head validation passed. The PR reports a fresh 18-answer targeted run. The broad 33-case comparison showed no statistically significant overall gain and private cases were unavailable.

matching_prs.title: Capture kentcdodds.com PR #890 D1 isolate-cache lessons
matching_prs.weakness: An initial safe fixture missed a real false positive found during validation against five repositories. The detector confused a per-call result accumulator with state retained between requests.
matching_prs.remedy: Added the real-world shape to the safe fixture and a minimal pair distinguishing function-local from module-scope state.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: Commit 291dea17 adds test_function_local_accumulator_map_is_not_flagged and the accumulator source. The final near-miss table changes where the map lives while keeping the D1 aggregate.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Turn a field-discovered false alarm into a near-miss differing in the one property that matters for the contract.
matching_prs.outcome: Open PR with successful head validation. The report about five live repositories comes from the PR. It concerns a detector developed on this branch.

matching_prs.title: Teach Cloudflare Doctor to block crawler-amplified D1 page work
matching_prs.weakness: Keyword-level grading could accept the correct verdict paired with a wrong cost equation, an incomplete route fix or an unsupported source. A previously reviewed case had already affected the oracle.
matching_prs.remedy: Built a structural checker of per-route evidence, mechanism and remediation, deliberately wrong answers and valid examples for all supported verdicts. Relabeled the reviewed scenario as a frozen regression.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: Tests reject headings and keywords without rows, distinct keys substituted for repeated uncached requests, and a fix confined to a dynamic route. Other cases require official support for caching claims or accept valid BLOCK, PASS and CONDITIONAL.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Test a plausible wrong explanation alongside the right conclusion. When a case shapes the rubric, report it as regression coverage.
matching_prs.outcome: Head validation passed. Committed evidence covers two models on focused fixtures and a previously reviewed regression. It cannot establish generalization to independent incidents.

matching_prs.title: Run npm test in CI, fail overdue evidence reviews, and add near-miss and detection-eval tests
matching_prs.classification: explicit verification audit and integration of #27
matching_prs.weakness: A handwritten CI command list drifted from npm test, a separate workflow ran a duplicate check, expiry could warn indefinitely, and a hard-coded test date drifted when the policy was reviewed.
matching_prs.remedy: Made CI run the canonical local commands, removed the duplicate workflow, tested the policy's warning/failure boundary and CLI exit, and incorporated #27's tests.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The workflow invokes npm test and npm run eval:validate. The expiry tests assert warning through the grace boundary, error one day later and CLI status 1. The link-policy test computes due date + 1. The two #27 test files have identical Git blob IDs in both PRs.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Give CI and maintainers one test entry point. Assert the warning-to-failure transition and its exit code before deleting a redundant gate.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged and head validation passed. This is the landing PR for #27's near-miss and evaluator tests. Their mutation results are a single item of evidence across both PRs.

matching_prs.title: Test audit: near-miss controls for 16 detectors and a detection eval that can go red
matching_prs.weakness: Of 25 positively tested detectors, the audit found 19 without a fixture explicitly forbidding them. The all-passing fixture suite did not establish that the evaluator's rules or exit statuses could fail.
matching_prs.remedy: Added 16 table-driven positive/near-miss pairs and eight evaluator tests. Reviewed an initial pair that froze a heuristic threshold and removed dependence on an unrelated file-level shortcut.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: Each pair asserts the same check ID is present on the positive and absent on its near-miss. Temporary real-scanner fixtures test missing/forbidden IDs, budgets, evidence scoped to required findings, and exits 0/1/2 for good/mixed/empty sets. The N+1 positive uses 10 queries, away from a tunable threshold of six.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Widen a rule to check its near-miss, silence it to check the corresponding positive, and break each evaluator condition. Leave tuning latitude for non-contract thresholds. Verify the tested revision when reusing a detached worktree.
matching_prs.outcome: Closed without merging as a standalone PR. GitHub checks passed and both new test blobs landed through #26. The author's planted-bug table reports 2/19 to 18/19 widened guards and 0/6 to 6/6 evaluator faults caught. One file-level heuristic was deliberately unpinned. Wrangler fake fidelity remained unverified.

matching_prs.title: Clarify general Cloudflare cost-audit principles
matching_prs.weakness: A first structural grading run rejected five independently assistant-reviewed synthetic answers over presentation details, equivalent descriptions and how rows were grouped.
matching_prs.remedy: An intermediate commit added parser regressions accepting equivalent answers and rejecting wrong arithmetic and unsupported claims. The branch later removed that evaluation along with the narrow feature.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: Commit eebca3ac records failures for heading/emphasis, deep vs shallow cohorts, split rows with shared frequency and equivalent index descriptions. The regression suite includes split-row answers and keyword-stuffed/wrong arithmetic answers. Commit d70fd16a removes the suite and receipt from the current head.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Keep the initial grades and unchanged answers when fixing an overly specific grader. Treat the regrade as grader development and use fresh answers for any later effectiveness claim.
matching_prs.outcome: Open PR. GitHub validation passed on both historical and current heads. The intermediate receipt reports 0/5 to 5/5 when regrading identical answers, with assistant review. Native paired evaluation was blocked by authentication. These tests are absent from the current PR diff.

matching_prs.title: Clarify Workflow billing and add regression evals
matching_prs.classification: explicit regression evaluation within billing update
matching_prs.weakness: The original documentation guard accepted generic text while the underlying billing rule changed. Ambiguous worksheet flags also produced a spurious apparent model gain.
matching_prs.remedy: Paired old and new guards against three locally altered documents and tested a typed worksheet oracle with one wrong field at a time. Clarified ambiguous cases and reran them.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The old guard checks Steps/August 10. Tests assert the old policy accepts each semantic mutation and the new one reports content-drift. Worksheet tests reject numbers as strings, booleans, wrong values and contradictory duplicate worksheets.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Alter the fact a drift guard promises to protect while preserving generic page text. Vary a single typed answer field and reject contradictory duplicates.
matching_prs.outcome: Head validation passed. The PR reports the old/new guard comparison as 0/3 vs 3/3 and 18/18 billing worksheets for all three model variants. The evaluation establishes no billing-answer accuracy gain.

matching_prs.title: Fix audit scope, false alarms, and workload checks found in Dataflare
matching_prs.weakness: The judge could call an observed scanner result fabricated because it lacked the execution trace. Old verdicts could also be reused after the grading evidence changed.
matching_prs.remedy: Forwarded observed commands, outputs and permissions to the judge. Fingerprinted grading inputs and added controls for a legitimate scan, a false attribution, failed commands, missing logs and stale cached verdicts.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The forwarding test checks scanner_output and exit_code from the trace. A quoted mention cannot stand in for a run. Changing receipt A to receipt B invalidates a cached verdict. The detection runner also gained tests for missing required and present forbidden products.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Give evaluators the admissible evidence they need and bind cached assessments to it. Check a credible true claim and a plausible false attribution against the same evidence.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged and head validation passed. Published focused results cover four judge controls and eight audits of known cases. They establish a targeted correction, with residual imprecision in recommendation wording.

exclusions.reason: Example/config wording, retrospective documentation, agent metadata or install pin. #2 changes the trigger example extension. #4 documents lessons about pre-existing CI.
Dependency or harness version changes without repaired checks. #34 contains vendor release notes.

New product-check fixtures or ordinary feature regression coverage. #25 also bumps hard-coded test dates with new data. #37 refreshes stale report rows without changing those pre-existing fixtures' assertions.
Lint-only or action-pinning policy work. #33 checks workflow dependency references with zizmor.
CI event filtering or cancellation only.

limitations: Open, withdrawn and merged efforts have distinct outcomes. #27's two new test files are byte-identical in merged #26. #28's evaluator repair was removed in branch history. #16 and #17 describe the same original cross-detector false alarm from complementary directions.

All changed filenames were recovered. GitHub omitted inline patches for 40 files across #3, #11, #12, #15, #30 and #36, including unchanged renames and large generated evidence. The cited source changes, historical commits and focused receipts were available.

GitHub check conclusions establish hosted job results for the observed commits. This read-only audit did not rerun the test suite, private cases, model evaluations or mutation trials. Numerical effectiveness claims are attributed to their originating records.
